name: Onei AI
tagline: The curated directory of AI tools, skills and MCP servers.
description: Onei AI is a curated directory of AI tools that lists AI apps, reusable skills for AI assistants and agents, and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers in one place. Search the catalogue without an account or browse by category and shared tags. Every entry has its own page with summary, pricing model, features, links and screenshots; MCP server pages include ready-to-copy install configs for Claude Code, Claude Desktop and other MCP clients. Submissions are reviewed before publishing. Browsing is free; the site is funded by clearly labelled sponsored placements.
